title: Insert Interval
description:
You are given a list of **non-overlapping** intervals `intervals` sorted by start time, where `intervals[i] = [start, end]`, and a new interval `newInterval`.

Insert `newInterval` so the list stays sorted and non-overlapping, merging any intervals that overlap with it (intervals that merely touch, like `[1,2]` and `[2,3]`, overlap). Return the resulting list.
constraints: intervals is sorted by start and has no overlaps.
hints: Intervals that end before the new one starts go first unchanged; intervals that start after it ends go last unchanged.
Everything in between overlaps: merge them by taking the smallest start and largest end.
